summary: All three task-owned proof files are implemented and committed with pre-commit hooks green (typecheck, scoped biome, check:fallow). The runner drives, per engine, a REJECT phase (owned server on rnr-s05-nonexistent-<runId>, real OpenAI rejections journaled), a LIVE phase (the ORI-RN-004/005 driver exports invoked in-process behind a journaling OwnedBackendHandle wrapper, device video + a passive screenshot/Vision-OCR observer, restart-generation record tagging), and a WEB-SELF phase (real Chromium on the driver's own exported dist through a teeing same-origin proxy on the dist's inlined port: timestamped raw SSE prefixes, exact raw-text sha256 == server record hash, growth-gated Stop with real abort propagation, real endpoint loss + Retry, and same-session provider-rejection -> restore -> Retry with one retained turn), then synthesizes the full per-target evidence contract, the digest-pinned manifest, teardown with model-restore verification, and a fail-closed validator. Behavioral RED for all four AC tests is bound at evidence/ORI-AI-002/proof.red; a ten-iteration web-only smoke against the real provider validated the entire web-self contract end to end (hash match TRUE, nonce-in-latest-user 0, mid-stream abort at 15 deltas, both failure/retry paths, restore verification). What remains red: the full six-target GREEN — uniwind iOS live legs fail mid-Maestro-flow (Android passed both appearance legs after the observer was moved off the device channel; iOS cause still under diagnosis — run 3's full diagnostic plus one more matrix run needed), so the vitest GREEN capture is not yet made. Matrix run 3 is still executing in the background (nativewind reject phase) and its outcome should seed cycle 2.
assumptions: AC-2 literal reading adjusted to the composed screen's real semantics: apps/example exposes its Retry control only on error states (ErrorBanner -> chat.retry); there is no post-Stop Retry control in the real UI, so the web session proves stop + post-abort recovery (a later request completing on a new id, ORI-RN-004's accepted pattern) and the Retry-with-exactly-one-retained-turn substance is proven per target through the real failure paths (endpoint-loss on all six, provider-rejection on web).

AC-3 case 2 on native targets cannot be expressed same-session through the landed drivers (their Retry loop cannot complete while the model stays bad and the handle dies with the child), so each native target gets the actual rejection (bad-model phase records + visible-error screenshot) and the restored-model recovery (live phase retry with exactly one retained turn) as separate current-run observations; the web target carries the literal same-session rejection -> restore -> Retry proof. Closing the native gap needs a failureModel/restore hook in both drivers — outside this task's writeAllowlist.

The uniwind driver writes its canonical evidence into evidence/ORI-RN-004/ (its declared fixed root) on every invocation; those writes are the driver's own behavior, are left uncommitted, and prior-run preservation for my task is handled by fresh run ids and non-destructive synthesis.
blockers: uniwind iOS live legs fail mid-Maestro-flow under this runner's orchestration (Maestro contention eliminated as the cause by switching the observer to passive screenshot+Vision-OCR — Android then passed both legs; remaining candidates: concurrent simctl recordVideo and stale Expo Go state after the reject phase); needs run 3's full leg diagnostic + one more matrix iteration.

The task's GREEN capture (vitest run of the four AC tests against a fresh full matrix) is pending the iOS leg fix; matrix run 3 is still executing in the background and will conclude after this report.
